text: Do not reuse the same photo repeatedly for the same person across posts (e.g. Dario Amodei); always vary the image for each appearance.
When a story's source has a real photo of a sign, poster, or screen, use that as the cover image instead of a generic building or stock photo.

By default every post must wait for Mahir's approval before publishing. Only when Mahir explicitly says to post without approval ("onay göndermeden at", "sormadan direkt at", "post without approval") should it be published directly without asking.
